Vanessa / Marissa — quick technical summary and what we can produce:  

Retention defaults and options:
- Access/event logs (per-request traces, token-level): default hosted retention = 90 days. For Redwood Dedicated customers we support contract-based retention up to 7 years; Private deployments can retain per-customer policy (on-prem).
- Audit/admin action logs (console changes, role changes, API key ops): default = 365 days for hosted; 3+ years available via Reserved Archive add-on.

Export formats & packaging:
- Primary export formats: NDJSON (line-delimited JSON) compressed (.ndjson.gz) for event streams; Parquet available for long-term analytics exports.
- Each export includes an export_manifest.csv listing filename, start/end timestamps, event count, and SHA256 checksum.
- Delivery options: secure S3 presigned URL (default), encrypted ZIP over our internal transfer bucket, or direct SFTP to customer endpoint if requested. All delivery methods generate a transfer log that we include.

Deletion / erasure proofing:
- Deletion is recorded as immutable tombstone events in the audit log with a deletion_event_id. Exports can include the deletion_event slice which contains the resource id + deletion timestamp + actor id.
- For physical removal we record the storage lifecycle steps and produce a deletion_manifest with object keys and hashes. We can produce a signed attestation PDF that references the deletion_manifest and the export hashes; attestation is signed by the Redwood compliance officer and timestamped using our internal timestamp service (RFC3339).
- Chain-of-custody: we provide the S3 access logs (URL retrieval timestamps + requester IP), the export_manifest.csv (with SHA256), and the audit record ids. For additional assurance we can include a signed, time-stamped hash of the manifest (SHA256) in the attestation.

Redaction options:
- Exports can be produced in raw or redacted mode. Redacted mode removes/obfuscates IP addresses, user identifiers, and full request bodies by default; we can support field-level redaction on request. Note that redaction will affect forensic traceability and should be agreed in advance with auditors.

Next steps (what I will deliver):
- Produce a one-day sample in NDJSON + manifest and staged S3 presigned URL by EOD Aug 4.
- Draft deletion_attestation_draft.pdf referencing the sample manifest and preliminary hashes (Marissa will review language).

Attachments (technical): sample_export_20250720.ndjson.gz (example), export_manifest_20250720.csv (example)

--
Sean Gallagher
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
